notes.title: Update 2023-01 No.2: Save/Load Run and Minimap
notes.notes:
Hey all !

There are some new features for Endless Zombie Tower:

Save and load current run (Single player only)
Minimap (Optional)
Brightness settings
Reload if gun was empty only (Optional)
Flashlight restores last state on next floor start

[previewyoutube=2ZIq8paiTOM;full][/previewyoutube]

Get it now
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1607770/Endless_Zombie_Tower

Thank you for playing!

Greetings
NoserverStudios

notes.title: Endless Zombie Tower Release 1.0
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=ki4ZjIop5j4;full][/previewyoutube]
This update brings new playable floors, one boss level and full version of our game.

The game supports 100 playable floors. 100. floor is special boss level including special boss zombie.

Changes v1.0:

Boss enemy
End boss 100. floor
Floors up to 100
End of Early Access
Bug fixes
New engine version

Thanks for playing and your support ! ːsteamhappyː
We wish a nice day and have fun
NoserverStudios
